result.question: What warning did Zebul send to Abimelech about Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers?
result.answer: That they had come to Shechem and were stirring up the city against him.
result.reason: The original “Why” is ambiguous because the passage also mentions Zebul’s anger and his tactical instructions. Asking what warning he sent preserves the intended fact and is directly supported by the source wording.
